## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to state the close boundary of a [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](../classes/gmeow-NamedPeriod.md) as a [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md); omit it for a period still in progress (e.g. the current geologic epoch).

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at a bare dateTime (the range is [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md), which carries its own frame) and avoid asserting two ends (functional — exactly one).

### How to use

- Point it at a single [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) carrying its value, frame, and granularity; pair with [`gmeow:periodStart`](gmeow-periodStart.md) to delimit a closed period.

### Examples

- ex:victorianEra [`gmeow:periodEnd`](gmeow-periodEnd.md) ex:victorianEndInstant.
